QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize()` returns `{}` when `tokenizer_` is unset." and "On failure, `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize()` returns an empty vector."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says failure yields an empty vector and that the backend returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It never says these are the same value, so a caller can't tell them apart. Its "cannot tell success from failure" point is about empty input, not about the unwired case.
